slides.sub: Detach from what no longer serves.

slides.body: A dasha (planetary period) is like a season of life. Ketu's season is about release, not punishment.
Ketu is the shadow planet of detachment and depth. In its dasha, old goals can lose their shine. That is a signal, not a failure.
Think of it as cutting features that no longer serve. You narrow focus and go deep into one craft instead of staying broad.

points: Drop one commitment that drains you
